name: St. Clair County, MI
findings: St. Clair County has 460 nonprofit organizations. 173 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 143 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, St. Clair County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 29 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in St. Clair County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 arts and cultural organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 10 would.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Community organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 12 community organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
